contents.name: Snapshot
contents.description: Point-in-time health readings taken at tick time. The REST source is push-only and has no upstream connection or schedule to read at tick time, so this object is empty.

contents.name: Windowed
contents.description: Windowed health observations accumulated since the last health tick.

fields.name: PostFailureRatio
fields.description: Share of POST requests received since the last health tick that were not accepted (0.0–1.0): requests rejected as invalid (HTTP 400, e.g. unknown StreamId or MachineID/SensorID, empty value) and requests that could not be queued for the agent (HTTP 500). 0.0 when every request was accepted and also when no request was received at all.
